title: Assurance content preparation
description: Governance prepares assessor-supplied method, observation, applicability, coverage and judgment content for explicit recording, preserving incomplete scope and actual semantic authority.

operations.name: prepare_assurance_content
operations.purpose: Prepare inspectable assurance content and reliance diagnostics for a guided assessor without executing techniques, inventing judgments or retaining records.
inputs: Selected assurance content kind and stable identity, actor/contributor provenance, exact claim/criterion/subject basis and relevant conditions.
Assessor-supplied definition, observations, applicability rationale, coverage, contradiction dispositions or judgment and its supporting content.
Coherent selected record read, inspected subject observations and intended retention contract/scope; identified gaps and changes remain explicit.
preconditions: The participant identifies the requested content and scope. Missing required semantic context remains inspectable incompleteness; malformed or ambiguous identity rejects.
outputs: Exact prepared content and its attributable basis, identified missing context, affected criteria, reliance restrictions and remaining assessor decisions.
Complete-for-declared-purpose or incomplete content, or rejected preparation with diagnostics; never an inferred execution, saved record, approval or permission.
behavior: Apply MOD-007 assurance-content.md for FUNC-027–031 and AR-062–066; child allocation and judgment authority remain with their respective owners.
Keep method definitions, execution occurrences, actual observations, applicability, coverage and semantic judgments distinct; assess all selected criteria without silently narrowing the claim.
Use IF-010 claim-support meanings for applicability/coverage while requiring actual assessor reasoning and independence where policy requires it; no passing-label inference.
Reject justified favorable reliance that contradicts known gaps or unresolved material contradictions; return the assertion and diagnostic meaning without manufacturing a replacement judgment.
Return a prepared candidate only. MOD-012 carries actor-selected content through IF-004 and interprets actual retention; no direct storage call, implicit save or automatic retry.
Preserve original bases, relevant contrary evidence and unresolved obligations through replacement; current reassessment and historical completion retain distinct meanings.

failure_behavior.condition: Unsupported kind, ambiguous identity, unsupported selected contract or invalid request.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return actionable rejection without coercing a type, changing scope or mutating records.

failure_behavior.condition: Required state, conditions, evidence, provenance, independence or semantic reasoning is missing.
failure_behavior.outcome: Expose incomplete content and affected reliance; do not invent observations or a favorable judgment.

failure_behavior.condition: Current record or engineering basis changes before retention, or retention effects are unresolved.
failure_behavior.outcome: Require readback and proportionate reassessment of affected support; preparation never establishes saved state or authorizes blind replay.

consistency_rules: MOD-017 owns this external Governance boundary; MOD-007 owns preparation/assessment meanings and MOD-012 owns guided invocation and explicit recording.
IF-010 remains bounded support inspection and IF-009 remains authority. IF-014 does not supersede either contract.
MOD-018/010/011 preserve public command and persistence effects; successful storage supplies no semantic approval.
A human or agent supplies attributable reasoning. No universally authenticated actor identity, evidence discovery, automatic sufficiency engine or verification runner is promised.
compatibility_rules: Logical contract only: no public command, wire vocabulary, new record type, schema migration or implicit installed capability.

For selected v2/v4 recording use existing native fields plus explicitly retained supporting attachments where criterion/method detail lacks a field; unknown versions reject under the existing contracts.
Guidance realization and any future automation need their own qualified delivery; historical judgments retain their original scope.

sources.basis: Derive assessor-assisted assurance preparation, explicit retention cooperation and scoped reliance through MOD-007 and IF-014. Preserve actual judgment, command and persistence ownership; target Design only.
